Definition: properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks
BiblicalUsage: 1) to slip away, escape, deliver, save, be delivered; 1a)(Niphal); 1a1) to slip away; 1a2) to escape; 1a3) to be delivered; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to lay, let slip out (of eggs); 1b2) to let escape; 1b3) to deliver, save (life); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to give birth to; 1c2) to deliver; 1d) (Hithpael); 1d1) to slip forth, slip out, escape; 1d2) to escape
